ideas.pitch: A virtual simulation of a household renewable energy system that balances solar generation, battery storage, and dynamic load shifting.
ideas.problem_statement: Electronics Domain: Design sustainable hardware solutions using virtual simulation tools such as Tinkercad, Proteus, ModelSim, or Vivado focusing on energy efficiency.
ideas.title: EcoGrid: Solar-Battery Microgrid Energy Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Electronics Domain focus on energy efficiency and leverages the validated core logic of previous winning energy management systems.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based greenhouse simulation in Tinkercad that optimizes soil moisture and LED lighting using low-power renewable logic.
ideas.problem_statement: Electronics Domain: Design sustainable hardware solutions focusing on minimal material use and renewable logic using Arduino or ESP32 platforms.
ideas.title: SmartSprout: Automated Eco-Greenhouse Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines plant monitoring mechanics with proven gamified eco-friendly logic that has historically scored high wins.

ideas.pitch: A Computational Fluid Dynamics simulation optimizing micro-wind turbine blade geometry for maximum energy capture with minimal material waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Mechanical Domain: Advance sustainable mechanical design by building CAD models and conducting simulations using Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD).
ideas.title: FluidFlow: Eco-Friendly Wind Turbine Blade CFD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted specifically at the Mechanical Domain requirements, offering visual and mathematically validated efficiency gains that appeal to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A finite element analysis model of a structural automotive bracket redesigned with lattice structures to minimize material usage while maintaining load capacity.
ideas.problem_statement: Mechanical Domain: Validate and optimize eco-friendly solutions using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) focusing on minimal material use.
ideas.title: StressMorph: Lightweight Biodegradable Bracket FEA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates immediate manufacturing resource savings through advanced structural simulation, directly answering the sustainability goals of the track.

ideas.pitch: A Tinkercad circuit simulation combining an Arduino microcontroller and sensors to sort recyclable materials with high energy efficiency.
ideas.problem_statement: Electronics Domain: Design sustainable hardware solutions using virtual simulation tools such as Tinkercad built around Arduino or ESP32 platforms.
ideas.title: SortAI: Virtual Smart Waste Classifier Circuit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven robotics and hardware classification winning architecture into a clean, waste-free virtual simulation format.
